met_analysis:
The trough in easterlies from Comorian area to South Interior Karnataka across Tamilnadu & Keralam extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gujarat & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining north Odisha- south Gangetic West Bengal coasts at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation is likely to emerge over South Andaman Sea around 29th November 2026.
